name: Command Code
notes: Pay-as-you-go: each model has real per-token prices, so this is not a Subscription Provider. Use the key only for your own applications: never share it or resell access to it. CommandCode's Terms restrict resale, benefiting third parties and more than one account per person, although its docs invite any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible client; ask support@commandcode.ai if unsure. The Go plan has no API access. Claude models are served only on /messages, so none are shipped. DeepSeek prices are the PEAK prices (peak is 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday to Friday; off-peak is half the price on the pricing page). The optional x-cmd-zdr header is not used. No exhaustedErrorCodes: the Provider doesn't document the status or code it answers with once a quota runs out; add the quirk once a real Error Capture shows it. No quota reader: no quota endpoint is documented. Left out on purpose: models gated to the GOAT plan and above or restricted by region, -fast and -ultrafast variants, typesafe and jev (System One), preview models, and the Claude, Gemini and Grok models.

upstreamModels.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro
upstreamModels.notes: Prices (per 1M tokens, USD) are from CommandCode's pricing page; the context size is what the live /models endpoint reports. Max output, capabilities and release date are not published by CommandCode and come from models.dev (its commandcode entry). Cache write is not published and is set to the input price. The price is the peak price (01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday to Friday), double the off-peak price on the pricing page, so Cost is never understated.
